summary: Phase 2 end-to-end testing (Registry, Website Builder + Public RSVP, Vendor Boost, WhatsApp Blast, AI Planner). 19/19 new pytest cases pass against the deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Playwright flows for all 5 features pass end-to-end: couple can configure amplop digital, build+publish website, public RSVP syncs into the owner's guest list, blast opens wa.me and marks sent, vendor can upgrade to premium via Midtrans stub and the vendor tier bumps on /api/my/vendor. AI FAB opens with full UI (ai-fab/ai-panel/ai-input/ai-send/ai-prompt-*). Backend AI /api/ai/chat with Claude Sonnet 5.5 responded with a non-empty reply + session_id (one call per the rate-limit guidance). Security spot-checks all green (401 without token, 403 for wrong role, password-gated website does not leak events/story on wrong password).

minor.issue: PUT response does not include `contributions` or `total_idr` while GET /api/registry does — frontend spreads PUT response into state after Save, which can cause the UI total to render stale when combined with later optimistic updates. Suggest: either enrich PUT response to include contributions+total_idr (same shape as GET) OR have frontend re-GET after save.

ui_bugs.issue: After adding a contribution via UI, data-testid=registry-total still rendered Rp 0 (optimistic update math uses `reg.total_idr + r.data.amount_idr`, but `newContrib.amount_idr` may be 0 when Playwright fills the type=number input via `fill`). Backend row IS created correctly (verified via pytest). Fix idea: coerce `newContrib.amount_idr` from the latest input value in onSubmit instead of relying on state, or re-GET /registry after a successful POST. Low priority — human users typing a number work fine; automation flake.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Enrich PUT /api/registry response to mirror GET (include contributions + total_idr) OR have RegistryPage re-GET after Simpan Pengaturan / addContrib so the total always matches the server.

(Optional/minor) In RegistryPage.addContrib, compute total from the just-returned contribution and use `r.data.amount_idr` which is guaranteed server-side (already done); additionally guard against stale `newContrib.amount_idr=0` by reading from the number input ref.
critical_code_review_comments: phase2.py is 540 lines — within limits but close to the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into /app/backend/phase2/{registry,website,boost,blast,ai}.py as Phase 3 lands.

Website password check in /website/public/{slug} does a plain equality compare (`password != site['password']`). For 'high security' as requested in the problem statement, store a hash (bcrypt) of the password and compare via constant-time check to prevent timing attacks + plaintext storage. Also, the lock-response leaks bride_name/groom_name which is probably desired, but confirm with product.
simulate-paid endpoint is auth-gated to the order owner (user_id match) which is correct; however it has no idempotency token or signature — safe only because it is explicitly a stub.
AI rate limit uses in-memory deque per user. On process restart or multi-worker deployment the limit resets / is per-worker. For production, back with Redis or Mongo TTL collection.
LlmChat is instantiated per request and the full history is folded into the system prompt. Works, but for long sessions this will inflate token usage. Consider summarizing or truncating older turns.

/api/website/public/{slug}/rsvp sync-to-guest-list uses case-insensitive regex on `data.name`. `re.escape` is applied (good), but a stray `^$` match could still collide on common names (e.g., two 'Ani's would overwrite each other's RSVP). Consider also matching on phone_wa or appending a short suffix when overwriting.
No rate limit on public RSVP endpoint — a bot could spam a published invitation and bloat the owner's guest list. Suggest a per-slug/IP throttle.
/api/boost/plans intentionally public (OK). /api/boost/mine and /api/boost/orders correctly require auth.
Blast message is URL-encoded via quote(…, safe=''). Good.

Registry: QRIS url is accepted as any string via pydantic Optional[str] (not HttpUrl). Fine, but you may want to validate scheme to prevent 'javascript:' injection if the URL is ever rendered as href (currently rendered as which is safe-ish).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of phase 2 flows end-to-end: registry save+add bank+log contrib, website build+publish+banner, public /u/{slug} RSVP syncs to owner guest list, blast preview+send+sent-badge, vendor boost premium purchase + tier bump, AI FAB open+UI complete.

rca of the issue: Only minor issue: RegistryPage shows stale total in UI after fill(number) via Playwright. RCA: `newContrib.amount_idr` is a number in state; `onChange={(e) => setNewContrib({...newContrib, amount_idr: parseInt(e.target.value || 0)})}` depends on React fire of the input change event. Playwright's `fill` triggers input events, but the subsequent submit may read state before React has committed the setState. The DB row is correctly created (confirmed with backend pytest). Mitigation: either use ref + submit-time read, or re-GET /registry after insert.
